create_ViT_model: create a Vision Transformer model with patch dropout for image classification
build_PatchDropout_layer: build a patch dropout layer that randomly drops patches during training
build_Attention_module: build a multi-head self-attention module with qkv projection and softmax
build_Transformer_encoder: build a transformer encoder with stacked attention and feed-forward layers
test_ViT_forward_pass: test the ViT forward pass on image tensors to produce classification logits
